svg.title: Median request throughput by workload
svg.desc: A faceted grouped bar chart shows actual median requests per second for Envoy with libmodsecurity and Envoy with the Coraza Dynamic Module. Workloads are grouped into three panels with explicitly labeled independent linear ranges. Envoy-only throughput is shown as a numeric, uninspected reference outside the panel axes.

g.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: Requests/s · higher is faster · independent linear ranges (compare within each section) · 3 runs
Sections use independent linear ranges; compare bar lengths only within a section. Bar/marker = median; line = observed min–max (not a confidence interval).
Envoy-only numbers are uninspected references outside the panel axes; attack rows are not security-equivalent; ‡ baseline uses direct-response 403.
Linux x86_64 · Envoy 1.39.0 · OWASP CRS v4.28.0 · 1 Envoy worker · GitHub Actions run 29941453306 · input SHA-256 6d9a1a0c1d62…
